rows.text: Trick 1: Bayes template: P(Ei|A) = P(Ei)P(A|Ei) / ΣP(Ek)P(A|Ek) — label causes E1, E2… and the observation A; fill a two-column table.  ·  Trick 2: The denominator is the TOTAL probability of the observation — compute it first; every Bayes numerical is one division.
